artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Repo tool script, nothing deploys. THE FIX (LGIC_NAMING-S21): `_channel_row_ids(code)` used to glob `WORKSPACE` (this script's OWN checkout) unconditionally, so a checker running from one checkout but graded against an instance whose channel row is committed in a DIFFERENT checkout (a linked worktree, a side branch) read that row as absent. New `_instance_checkout_root(inst_path)` walks up from the instance path to the nearest `.git` entry (dir or file, covering a linked worktree) and returns that as the channel root, falling back to WORKSPACE when `inst_path` is None or no `.git` is found above it -- so every caller that omits `inst_path` (the pre-existing self-test arms A-L, any caller injecting `row_ids` directly) is byte-identical to before. `_channel_row_ids` grows an optional `root` parameter (default WORKSPACE, unchanged default). `surprises_check` grows an optional `inst_path` parameter threaded to `_channel_row_ids` only when `row_ids` is not injected. `main()` now passes `inst_path=Path(args[0])` into `surprises_check`, mirroring the pattern `artifact_resolution_check` already uses for the same argument. Every OTHER limb (`_governing_is_tree`/`_resolve_governing_to`, alignment, artifact-resolution, invocation-alignment, count-bar, drives, binding) is untouched -- confirmed by AC2's 45-of-45 self-test, which re-exercises every pre-existing arm unchanged plus the new arm M.
introduces: root: Path | None = None) -> tuple[set, int]
